suffertus (sufferctus , Lucil. ap. Gell. 4, 17, 3), a, um, adj. sub - farcio,
I.crammed full, full (very rare): “subicit suffectus posteriorem, Lucil. l. l.: aliquid se sufferti tinniturum,” something full-sounding, sonorous, Suet. Ner. 20 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
